en.title: Spider-Man Dominates Labor Day Box Office, Nears All-Time Domestic Record
en.summary: As summer winds down, 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' continues its reign atop the box office, aiming for a historic domestic run. Tom Holland's other major film, 'The Odyssey,' also makes a strong showing, securing the second spot.
en.body:
The end of summer brings a familiar champion back to the top of the box office charts. **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** has officially secured its sixth consecutive weekend at No. 1, a remarkable feat that places it on a trajectory to potentially become the highest-grossing domestic film of all time. The latest web-slinging adventure, starring **Tom Holland**, has resonated deeply with audiences, drawing crowds to theaters week after week.

Competing for attention during the Labor Day weekend, **The Odyssey**, another major release also featuring **Tom Holland**, has landed comfortably in the second position. This dual success underscores **Holland**'s significant star power and his ability to anchor multiple blockbuster films simultaneously. While **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** is on the cusp of breaking domestic box office records, **The Odyssey** is steadily marching towards a $600 million domestic gross, proving that audiences are eager for compelling narratives across different genres.

## A Six-Weekend Reign

The box office numbers for **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** are nothing short of astonishing. The film has now grossed nearly $1 billion domestically, a figure that places it in elite company. Its sustained popularity, even as new films vie for attention, speaks to the franchise's enduring appeal and the effective marketing that has kept audiences engaged. The film’s ability to maintain its top position for six consecutive weekends is a testament to its broad appeal, captivating both dedicated cinephiles and casual moviegoers.

## The Odyssey's Strong Finish

Meanwhile, **The Odyssey** has carved out a significant space for itself, earning $588 million in North America. The film’s performance alongside **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** indicates a strong market for event cinema, particularly when anchored by popular stars. The fact that both films are performing so strongly, with one potentially setting an all-time record and the other achieving massive success, paints a very healthy picture for the box office as the summer movie season concludes. The competition between these two major releases highlights the current strength of the theatrical experience.

## What's Next

With **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** nearing its domestic box office goal, all eyes will be on whether it can surpass the all-time record. Meanwhile, **The Odyssey** continues its impressive run, with its final domestic gross still to be determined. Details regarding any potential re-releases or home media availability for both films have not yet been announced.

content_raw: The Spider-Man feature is soon aiming to become the top grossing movie domestically of all time, as Tom Holland's other summer movie, 'The Odyssey,' comes in at No. 2.
